c74object.name: evi.ringmod.diode~
c74object.description: Piece-wise approximation of a 4-diode ring modulator, naive implementation heavily oversampled for clean anti-aliasing, so not very efficient. But it has it's own interesting sound and is very different to evi.ringmod~.

inlet.description: First signal to be ring modulated (Carrier).
Second signal to be ring modulated (Modulator).

outlet.description: Audio output of the ring modulator.

objarg.name: upsample
objarg.description: Oversampling factor for the core ring modulator algorithm. Can be 16, 32 or 64. Default 32. Can only be a typed in argument.

attribute.name: knee
attribute.description: Soft knee..Hard knee 0..1. A harder knee increases the asymmetrical saturation in the diodes.

attribute.name: slope
attribute.description: Soft..Hard 0..1. Slope increases the gain staging at the input to the diodes.

attribute.name: voltage
attribute.description: Increasing the voltage not only increases the gain but also smooths the diode shaping leading to more intelligable harmonics.

c74object.discussion: @see: 'A Simple Digital Model of the Diode-based Ring-Modulator', DAFx-11, 2011, by Julian Parker.
